79596.subject: What is the world’s loveliest language?
79596.body:
The Economist Picks

Автор: The Economist


Автор: The Economist

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/what-worlds-loveliest-language-the-economist-t0aee?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bc6BeYJsuT%2Fm4BilQxBF8Rg%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=30MsvDN8UlgYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mue0coj4~tu-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mue0coj4-tu
  
Sign up for free here to receive this newsletter in your inbox every Saturday. You’ll also get our weekly newsletter with an exclusive introduction from our senior editors. Most people have a vague sense that some languages just seem prettier than others. And if you are a language-learner, maybe there are ones you just enjoy speaking more than others. (I freely confess a soft spot for Brazilian Portuguese.) You might think your views would be widely shared by any observer. You might be surprised. This proposition has been tested by a group of researchers who played identical texts in dozens of languages to speakers who themselves spoke several different languages. The conclusion: a universal linguistic beauty queen is hard to find. Most languages were rated pretty similarly—and the one that won the highest rating is probably not one you would guess. 79590.subject: Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse AI Agent to protect $76 billion in ad revenue ✋🤖; 𝕏’s Everything App now sits where r…
79590.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1129

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re breaking down Amazon's decision to block Meta's Muse AI agent [ https://substack.com/redirect/fd923acf-399e-4954-8234-bc99faaddbb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] from its retail site to see why this is really a fight over $76 billion in advertising revenue, not terms of service (why an AI agent that skips the search results page threatens both the sale and the ad impression on top of it, why Shopify made the opposite bet the same week by opening Shop Pay to Muse through Meta's new connector program [ https://substack.com/redirect/53dab469-c6e1-4f5a-93f5-03bc2604cd5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], & what to watch next + bonus deep dives into Anthropic’s Strategy to Win Agentic Commerce [ https://substack.com/redirect/0050100b-c29e-4343-8ddf-a7289eae8444?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Agentic Transition Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/85b9870b-7ded-46df-a910-ce8dcb408d16?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving into 𝕏's new Trade button for cashtags to see how 𝕏 continues to build its Everything App (why 𝕏 sends users to brokers instead of becoming one, what Robinhood's absence from the list of partners means, why the data is 𝕏's biggest win, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dive into Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS [ https://substack.com/redirect/f4024a36-77ec-4b79-8802-9b7ea9c2f4e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the spicy stuff 🌶️
Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse AI Agent to protect $76 billion in ad revenue ✋🤖
The BIG News 🔥 The first real platform war over AI agents started Sunday night, and it’s not about terms of service.
Amazon blocked Meta’s Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/fd923acf-399e-4954-8234-bc99faaddbb0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] from its retail site two weeks after the personal AI agent launched and rose to No. 1 on the U.S. App Store. Amazon $AMZN  says Muse operated without prior authorization, failed to identify itself, and may mishandle user credentials. A spokesperson framed it as an opt-in question, comparing agentic commerce to food delivery apps that need restaurant consent.
But remember that Amazon has a $76.1 billion annual advertising business at stake, and an AI agent that skips the search results page threatens every dollar of it. So the advertising economics explain the real reason behind the block, and what Shopify $SHOP  did the same week shows where the market goes from here.
Let’s dive in...
